newsitem.title: USA: Braun's expects to end bankruptcy Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: Braun's expects to end bankruptcy Dec 2.

text.p: Braun's Fashions Corp said it expects to emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy on December 2 after its Plan of Reorganization was approved Friday by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware.
It said creditors and shareholders overwhelmingly voted in favor of the plan.
Under the plan, creditors are to be paid 100 percent of their allowed claims, with distributions to begin as early as December 1996.
It said Norwest Bank, the company's debtor-in-possession, agreed to provide a $10 million post-petition revolving credit facility through April 1, 1999.

Braun's also said same-store sales in the 171 continuing store group have increased 11 percent from the July 2, 1996 bankruptcy petition date to November 21. It said performance is running ahead of the company's business plan.
The specialty retailer sells women's fashions in 20 states.
